chapter: Teaching, the 1951 Big Show and New York nights
title: Strayhorn's 'Strange Feeling' for his planned album
summary: Collins plans to record the rarely played Strange Feeling and shows Jimmy Jones the Strayhorn record.

story.theme_name: Duke Ellington and his orchestra, as others knew them
story.community_name: Duke Ellington: the band, the man, his men

blocks.x: As a matter of fact I'm going to do one of the tunes of Billy Stray Horn for his next album that I'm doing to

do, Strange Feeling. And nobody has ever done it. I -- are you aware of this tune? It's a beautiful tune. So Jimmy Jones was over my house a few days ago, and I said, Jimmie, look, here's a tune that I'm going to do. He said, oh, yeah, I know that tune. I said, yeah, have you heard this recording here, that Stray Horn did as piano and voices. Do you have this "Peaceful" side of Billy Stray Horn. Oh yes, I have it.

Okay, I said listen to this tune. Jimmie said, you know, I never heard this. And everybody's talking about "Lush Life." What about "strange feeling", it's a beautiful tune. Strictly Stray Horn. But I'm going to do it on this album, you know.
So these are some of the -- 1951, and I think I met you in 1950, around that time, '51.
